# Synthetic thumbnail video

`thumbnail.webm` is a locally generated silent 1920 × 1080 VP8 WebM test fixture, approximately 2.4 seconds. Its frames contain alternating solid colors and a frame counter. It was produced with an HTML canvas, `canvas.captureStream(30)` and `MediaRecorder`; no camera, microphone, uploaded customer media or production recording was used.

The committed fixture is byte-for-byte identical to `/tmp/hwads-validation/test.webm`, generated by the validation session's canvas-only `make-video.mjs`. Verified SHA-256: `7dec3a0e5ba1b5715b0f68657cf515d740635d9f58b75e99b7b95843b78b4ce9`.

Purpose: deterministic content for native media and video-thumbnail browser tests. It contains no private audio or imagery.
